campaign: Northeast Ohio Treasure Hunt — Tom Colosimo Subscription Demo

modules.label: Loyalty
modules.title: Hunter Passport
modules.subtitle: Turn an anonymous treasure hunter into a customer you can reward again.
modules.description: The first step captures the relationship. Hunters join once, receive a digital Places Rewards passport and begin earning value from participating businesses instead of disappearing when the hunt ends.
bullets: One join creates an ongoing customer relationship
Reward purchases, participation and local exploration
Creates the identity layer for every module that follows
modules.why_tom: The hunt can generate traffic; the passport makes that traffic retainable.

modules.label: Stamp Card
modules.title: 5-Stop Explorer Trail
modules.subtitle: Move hunters through multiple participating businesses instead of one clue location.
modules.description: A numbered digital trail turns community exploration into measurable merchant visits. Each qualifying stop adds progress toward a completion reward.
bullets: Five merchant stops with visible progress
Designed for cross-business discovery
Completion reward encourages the full route
modules.why_tom: Participating merchants can see a reason for hunters to visit them, not merely pass through town.

modules.label: Discovery
modules.title: Participating Business Discovery
modules.subtitle: Give every sponsor and merchant a visible place in the hunt ecosystem.
modules.description: Hunters can discover participating businesses, understand what each location offers and decide where to visit next without diluting the official treasure clues.
bullets: Featured participating-business profiles
Merchant-specific offer and visit reason
Creates value for sponsors before and after clue day
modules.why_tom: More visible merchant value makes sponsorship and participation easier to sell.

modules.label: Reward
modules.title: Clue Completion Bonus
modules.subtitle: Reward the behavior around the clue without changing the official clue itself.
modules.description: After a qualifying visit or verified activity, the hunter unlocks a local-business reward. This keeps the Treasure Hunt authentic while Places Rewards manages the commercial engagement surrounding it.
bullets: Separate reward logic from official clue logic
Merchant-funded local perks can be attached
Creates an immediate reason to engage after a clue
modules.why_tom: The original treasure remains untouched while merchants gain a measurable participation layer.

modules.label: Scratch & Win
modules.title: Mystery Bonus Scratch & Win
modules.subtitle: Add instant-win excitement at participating stops without affecting the treasure.
modules.description: A merchant can issue a digital mystery bonus after a visit. The participant scratches for a local perk, bonus points or another defined reward.
bullets: Instant gratification at participating locations
Configurable win rate and merchant prizes
Adds repeatable excitement between major clues
modules.why_tom: It adds fun and sponsor inventory while keeping the real treasure hunt fair.

modules.label: Milestone
modules.title: Community Explorer Milestone
modules.subtitle: Celebrate meaningful participation before the final treasure is found.
modules.description: Participants unlock a milestone reward after completing a defined combination of visits, stamps or campaign actions. It creates progress even for hunters who never find the main treasure.
bullets: Recognizes participation, not just the final winner
Can combine visits and reward progress
Keeps more hunters motivated deeper into the campaign
modules.why_tom: Thousands can feel progress even though only one person finds the main treasure.

modules.label: Referral
modules.title: Bring Another Hunter
modules.subtitle: Turn every participant into a measurable source of new participants.
modules.description: Each hunter receives a unique referral path. When another person joins through it, the system can reward both sides and attribute growth to the original participant.
bullets: Unique referral attribution
Reward the inviter and the new hunter
Organic event growth without relying only on paid promotion
modules.why_tom: The community helps grow the next hunt for you.

modules.label: VIP Tier
modules.title: Hunter VIP Progression
modules.subtitle: Give the most active local supporters a reason to keep advancing.
modules.description: Points, visits and participation can move hunters into higher recognition tiers with stronger local perks, early access and special experiences.
bullets: Visible progression beyond one event
Recognition for repeat local support
Creates premium experiences for highly engaged hunters
modules.why_tom: The hunt becomes a community membership engine instead of a one-time promotion.

modules.label: Voucher
modules.title: Hunter Comeback — $5 Off $25
modules.subtitle: Give a first-time hunt visitor a concrete reason to make the second purchase.
modules.description: A time-bounded comeback voucher converts hunt attention into measurable post-hunt spending at participating businesses.
bullets: Designed for a fast second visit
Minimum spend protects merchant economics
Redemption creates attributable post-hunt activity
modules.why_tom: This is where event traffic begins turning into merchant revenue after the hunt.

modules.label: Reviews
modules.title: Community Voice & Social Proof
modules.subtitle: Capture feedback after a strong experience and help participating businesses amplify it.
modules.description: The system asks at the right point in the journey for feedback, reviews or testimonials instead of leaving merchant reputation growth to chance.
bullets: Trigger feedback after positive engagement
Create merchant-specific reputation opportunities
Turn participant sentiment into proof for the next campaign
modules.why_tom: A successful hunt can leave participating businesses with lasting reputation value.

modules.label: Automation
modules.title: Post-Hunt Win-Back Automation
modules.subtitle: Keep the relationship working after the final clue and final prize.
modules.description: Participants who stop engaging can receive a timed return-visit reminder, merchant offer or preview of the next hunt. The system keeps doing the follow-up after the event team has moved on.
bullets: Automated thank-you and comeback sequence
Target inactive participants instead of messaging everyone
Build early interest for the next hunt
modules.why_tom: The marketing continues after the event without requiring Tom to manually chase thousands of people.

modules.label: Analytics & ROI
modules.title: Organizer ROI & Next-Hunt Dashboard
modules.subtitle: Show merchants, sponsors and organizers what the hunt produced beyond attention.
modules.description: The final module connects check-ins, rewards, referrals, return visits and campaign activity into a measurable story that can support renewals, sponsor conversations and the next hunt.
bullets: Measure participation across the full journey
Compare merchant and campaign performance
Use results to improve and sell the next hunt
modules.why_tom: This is the subscription closer: measurable value continues after the treasure is found.
